mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_metadata (file_id, filename, content_type, size, path, content, processing_status, processing_error, processed_at, tenant_id, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, content_hash) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{filename}, #{contentType}, #{size}, #{path}, #{content}, #{processingStatus}, #{processingError}, #{processedAt}, #{tenantId}, #{uploadedBy}, #{uploadedAt}, #{contentHash})
mapper.update: UPDATE file_metadata SET filename = #{filename}, content_type = #{contentType}, size = #{size}, path = #{path}, content = #{content}, processing_status = #{processingStatus}, processing_error = #{processingError}, processed_at = #{processedAt}, tenant_id = #{tenantId}, uploaded_by = #{uploadedBy}, uploaded_at = #{uploadedAt}, content_hash = #{contentHash} WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM file_metadata WHERE file_id = #{id})
